app.title: Soundscape Annotation Atelier
app.subtitle: Annotation tool for soundscape, field recording and electroacoustic composition.

projectsList.title: Saved projects
projectsList.empty: No saved projects yet. Load an audio and press Save to create one.
projectsList.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this project and the associated audio?

import.title: Import annotation
import.subtitle: Select a JSON v1.0 file exported from this app or compatible with the soundscape-audio-analysis toolkit. You will need to re-load the original audio file separately.
import.audioPrompt: Load the original audio file now to complete the import.
import.invalidSchema: Invalid schema: the JSON must have schemaVersion, audio, annotations fields.

welcome.title: Start by loading an audio file
welcome.subtitle: Drop an audio file above, or use the header button. Guaranteed formats: WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG. For .m4a files from iPhone Voice Memos, if decoding fails, convert to WAV with cloudconvert.com.
features: Controlled vocabulary: Schaeffer, Smalley, Schafer, Krause, Chion
Time markers with drag and resize on the waveform
JSON export compatible with the soundscape-audio-analysis toolkit
Local persistence with IndexedDB, no server upload
Bilingual IT/EN, installable as a PWA

errors.audioDecodeBody: The browser does not support this file's codec (this can happen with some .m4a files from iPhone Voice Memos using HE-AAC). Convert it to WAV or MP3 with an online converter (e.g. cloudconvert.com) and reload.

workbench.noSelection: No selection: click and drag on the waveform

panel.noAnnotations: No annotations yet, select a time range on the waveform and choose a term.
panel.noStructure: No structural sections yet, select a time range on the waveform and give the section a label.
panel.applyHint: First select a time range on the waveform

structure.title: Structural sections
structure.subtitle: Free annotations for macroform and interpretive notes. Kept separate from controlled annotations.
structure.label: Label
structure.labelPlaceholder: Opening, Development, Coda, Drone B, Transition...
structure.addHint: Drag a range on the waveform or type the times above.
structure.timeError: Invalid times: end must be greater than start.

annotation.orphanWarning: {{count}} annotation references a term no longer present in the current vocabulary. Likely a taxonomy update (the skill is the canonical source). Annotations remain valid but are no longer auto-mappable.
annotation.orphanWarning_plural: {{count}} annotations reference a term no longer present in the current vocabulary. Likely a taxonomy update (the skill is the canonical source). Annotations remain valid but are no longer auto-mappable.

export.title: Export
export.jsonDesc: Compatible with the soundscape-audio-analysis toolkit. Re-importable in this app.
export.pdfDesc: Typographic version with annotation table and visual timeline.

layers.title: Layers
layers.subtitle: Synchronic stratification: assign annotations to overlapping layers (foreground, background, simultaneous sources). Inspired by Aural Sonology.
layers.empty: No layers yet. Create one below, or promote a layer suggested by the skill.

notation.title: Notation (Aural Sonology)
notation.subtitle: Spectromorphological signs on the time axis. The analysis proposes a draft score: you confirm, correct, or add your own signs.
notation.selectFirst: First select a point or span on the waveform (drag to select), then pick a sign.
notation.guide1: Load the audio: the app proposes a first score of signs over the shape of the piece.
notation.guide2: Review the suggestions: confirm the right ones, ignore the rest.
notation.guide3: Add your own: pick a sign and click on the lane where you want it.
notation.guide4: Connect elements with a relation to show repetitions, contrasts, developments.
notation.activeHint: Active sign "{{name}}": click on the lane to place it.
notation.paletteHintArm: Pick a sign, then click on the lane to place it.
notation.laneHint: Drag a sign here, or click a sign and then here.

relations.title: Relations (form-building)
relations.subtitle: Connect two elements (annotations, sections, layers, signs) with a formal relation type. Provisional vocabulary, pending the book.
relations.needEntities: You need at least two elements (annotations, sections, layers or signs) to create a relation.

transformation.name: Transformation
transformation.desc: an element gradually morphs into another

development.name: Development
development.desc: elaboration and growth of a material

dissolution.name: Dissolution
dissolution.desc: disintegration or exhaustion of an element
